title: Journey - Seven Nights of Rest - Night 5: Quiet the mind

parts.style: warm, soft bedtime welcome, slow and unhurried
parts.text: Welcome to Seven Nights of Rest. <short pause> This is night five, Quiet the Mind. <short pause> If your thoughts turn toward harming yourself, please don't wait for sleep. Call your local emergency number or a crisis line now. <short pause> Otherwise, come with me to the bookshelf... where the big questions are kept.

A tired mind takes down the heaviest books. <short pause> How will it all turn out? <short pause> Why did it happen? <short pause> How can I fix every one of them? <short pause> David had a kingdom full of questions like that. <short pause> And he learned to be humble enough to leave some on the shelf. <short pause> This is Psalm one hundred thirty-one, verse one.

parts.style: reverent, very slow, reading scripture aloud
parts.text: Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

parts.style: tender, soft, slow, resting between sentences
parts.text: There is such relief in admitting that. <short pause> You were not made to understand everything, or to run the world from a pillow. <short pause> Some things belong on God's shelf. <short pause> He can reach it... <short pause> and you don't have to.

parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly
parts.text: Let's make that a breath prayer, with no holding and no counting. <short pause> As you breathe in... not mine to know. <short pause> As you breathe out... I am Yours. <short pause> Breathe in... not mine to know. <short pause> And out... I am Yours. <short pause> Keep it going gently, on your own.

parts.style: prayerful, very slow, soft but clearly spoken
parts.text: Lord, these matters are too high for me, and they are not too high for You. <short pause> Keep them safe. <short pause> Quiet my mind, and keep me small and near. <short pause> Amen.

parts.style: soft, very slow goodnight, resting between phrases
parts.text: Put out the light by the shelf. <short pause> The day is Yours... <short pause> I am counted... <short pause> I am covered... <short pause> Sleep is a gift... <short pause> Not mine to know. <short pause> Goodnight.
